name: Tint cycle
one_line: A background or scene palette drifts through a planned sequence of colours to mark time or mood
summary: The ground colour, or the whole scene's palette, moves slowly through a planned run of tints to signal dawn to dusk, a change of mood or a new chapter. It carries time passing and continuity without a cut. Steps must stay even in perceived lightness, and content on top has to remain readable at every point along the run.

routes.one_line: Interpolate between planned colour stops and fill a gradient on a 2D canvas

steps.does: Blend the planned stops from t and draw the ground gradient each seek

limits: Evidence includes a gradient, not a long colour run or perceptual-space blending
Canvas blends in sRGB by default, so lightness may dip between stops

routes.one_line: Tween a background colour on an element with seeked Web Animations API keyframes

steps.does: Give the ground element colour keyframes across the sequence, seeked from t

limits: Evidence covers transform, stroke draw and opacity, not colour properties
Browser colour interpolation space is not checked against the planned ramp

routes.one_line: Tween colour values on a seekable Anime.js timeline and apply them to the scene

steps.does: Tween colour values along the timeline and write them to ground and scene elements

limits: Evidence covers transform tween, SVG draw and stagger, not colour tweening
Interpolation space is the library's own; perceptual evenness is not shown

source: references/art-director §1.1 and §1.2, references/accessibility §5; tool records as of 2026-11-20
